coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall only. The primary Gaza publisher/collector remains authoritative. No production, publishing, approval, schedule, or public-site changes were made.

Search start conservatively includes the last explicitly reported completed check at approximately 06:44 PDT. No newer Gaza heartbeat was confirmed; the expanded window avoids assuming the intervening hourly check ran.
OCHA OPT checked first: https://www.ochaopt.org/ accessible; newest listed update dated 2026-10-09 (reported impact snapshot for 2026-10-07). No qualifying new post within this window.

WHO EMRO oPt checked second: https://www.emro.who.int/opt/ returned HTTP 502. WHO alternate EMRO news endpoint also returned 502. WHO global emergency URL used as fallback returned 404; targeted WHO-indexed results were older. Gaza health coverage is therefore incomplete.

Exactly 12 additional targeted web searches: WHO health capacity/medical evacuation/fuel; OCHA crossings/aid; WAFA injuries/hospital casualties; Reuters strikes/ceasefire; UNICEF water/child displacement; UNRWA aid; multiwire casualties; medical/ambulance/access; WAFA October 13 reports; Al Jazeera; UN humanitarian/crossings; ReliefWeb health/food/water.

Direct WAFA English home page accessible: https://english.wafa.ps/. Gaza-specific reports on October 13 currently visible (Al-Tuffah drone strike and Gaza 24-hour casualty update at 12:48 and 13:39 Palestine time, respectively) were already recorded in a previous watch and predate this observation window. Excluded as duplicates; West Bank items excluded as out of scope.

October 13 UN Women cumulative three-year casualty/injury estimate located by ReliefWeb search but not counted: historical aggregate, not a newly established in-Gaza incident. Direct ReliefWeb article returned HTTP 403.

No new source-verified and nonduplicate change in civilian casualties, displacement, aid and crossings, food/water, medical capacity, infrastructure, detention/hostages, negotiations, or operations with documented civilian impact was established. Search-engine indexing delays and blocked WHO coverage mean this is not proof that no event occurred.
